interface.signature: s: str, t: str, k: int -> bool

preconditions.description: The length of string s must be between 1 and 100,000.
The length of string t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The value of k must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: All characters in string s must be lowercase English letters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: All characters in string t must be lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The function returns True if s can be converted to t in k moves or less.
The function returns False if s cannot be converted to t in k moves or less.
